name: games
title: Games
description: Every game in one showcase, the installed ones and the ones you can still get, and their leaderboards. Enter opens a game, or installs it first and then opens it.
author: pal

store.tagline: Every game in one showcase, one Enter away
features: The game you are on shown large: its own screenshot, its tagline and what it is
A strip of every game's cover under it; the arrows walk it, a letter jumps to the next game starting with it
Games you have not installed yet are there too, after yours, marked Not installed
`enter` opens a game, or installs it, waits for it to load and opens it
`cmd+l` on a game shows its leaderboards: a tab per board, all time, this week or today, your own row marked, anonymous players hidden with `a`
A failed install says why on the game; `enter` tries again

screenshots.caption: The game you are on shown large, its screenshot and what it is; the strip under it walks every game, yours first
A game you do not have yet, marked Not installed: Enter installs it and starts it
A game's leaderboards: today's Wordle, fewest guesses first, anonymous players marked and your own row ringed

actions.title: Install and play
actions.description: On a game not installed: installs it from its registry, waits for it to load, opens it.

actions.title: Next game
actions.description: Moves along the strip (`left`, `up` or `shift+tab` go back); a letter jumps to the next game starting with it.

actions.title: Leaderboards
actions.description: The game's boards: `left` and `right` walk them, `p` the period, `a` hides anonymous players, `s` signs in when you are signed out.

games.title: Games
games.description: Every game, installed or on offer, as a showcase; Enter opens it, installing it first when needed.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: A game's leaderboards: a tab per board, the period, anonymous players shown or hidden. Opens on the last game looked at; G for another.
